abstract.text: Triggered when the user clicks on content between meta (URL) tags. If the meta is defined in BBCode, e.g. [code skip-lint]<a href=”{“key”: “value”}”>Text
`, then the parameter for this signal will always be a

type. If a particular type or an object is desired, the ``pushMeta(data:underlineMode:tooltip:)`` method must be used to manually insert the data into the tag stack. Alternatively, you can convert the ``String`` input to the desired type based on its contents (such as calling ``JSON/parse(jsonText:keepText:)`` on it).
